content: WASM binary size measurement in CI: (1) wasm-pack build --release produces the .wasm in pkg/; capture size with wc -c or du -b. (2) twiggy top <file.wasm> shows top contributors by size for optimization targeting. (3) wasm-opt from binaryen can further reduce size 10-15%. For CI size tracking: after wasm-pack build, emit size bytes to a JSON file committed to a .planning/baselines/ dir; CI job compares current build to committed baseline and fails if delta exceeds threshold (e.g. +5%). wasm-bindgen memory APIs (wasm_bindgen::memory()) expose current page count for runtime tracking but not peak allocation. cargo-bloat --target wasm32-unknown-unknown shows which functions contribute most to binary size.
